notes: Probabilities come from the frozen test split; nothing here was used for model selection.
B1 and B2 have no epistemic term by construction, so the register strikes that quantity instead of plotting it as zero.
A2 rescales probabilities only; its Dirichlet variance is not carried through calibration.
Every configuration in the main table reads the same data/splits.json split and the same evaluation code path, so the comparison is internally consistent.
Run variants recorded with fewer seeds than the main table are partial and are drawn as half-height rules.
